title: Contracted katakana: K, S and T rows — find the form
description: Use a Latin-letter spelling cue and base sign to distinguish small ャ/ュ/ョ from full-sized kana.

exercises.prompt: Which katakana spelling uses the キ base sign + small ya (kya)? Compare small and full-sized kana.
exercises.explanation: キャ is the contracted kya spelling. Small ャ joins キ; キヤ uses full-sized ヤ. These written forms are not interchangeable.

text.translation: Katakana kya: Small ャ joins キ; キヤ uses full-sized ヤ.
